flags.question: Which 3 products from 'Exotic Liquids' have been ordered the most in terms of quantity?

MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: 'Exotic Liquids'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)
RETURN p.productName, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalQuantity
ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC
LIMIT 3

flags.question: Which 3 suppliers have the most diverse range of product categories supplied?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT c.categoryID) AS categories
RETURN s.companyName, size(categories) AS categoryCount
ORDER BY categoryCount DESC
LIMIT 3
details: TypeQL uses reduce...count but Cypher has no COUNT()

flags.question: Identify the 5 customers who have ordered the most distinct categories of products.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category)
WITH c, cat.categoryID AS categoryID
ORDER BY c.customerID, categoryID
WITH c, collect(DISTINCT categoryID) AS categories
RETURN c.customerID, c.companyName, size(categories) AS distinctCategories
ORDER BY distinctCategories DESC
LIMIT 5
details: TypeQL uses reduce...count but Cypher has no COUNT()

flags.question: Which suppliers provide products to more than one region?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)
WHERE o.shipRegion IS NOT NULL
WITH s, COLLECT(DISTINCT o.shipRegion) AS regions
WHERE SIZE(regions) > 1
RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, regions

flags.question: Which 3 customers have purchased the most products from the 'Seafood' category?

WITH c, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalProducts

flags.question: What are the first 3 orders shipped via method '2' and have a discount?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product)
WHERE o.shipVia = '2' AND r.discount <> '0'
RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName, o.shipCity, o.shipCountry, o.shipPostalCode, o.shipAddress, o.shipRegion, o.shipDate, r.discount
ORDER BY o.orderDate
LIMIT 3

flags.question: Find the 5 suppliers whose products have never been out of stock.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)
WHERE p.unitsInStock > 0
WITH s, COUNT(p) AS totalProducts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.unitsInStock > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inStockProducts
WHERE totalProducts = inStockProducts
RETURN s.companyName
LIMIT 5
details: Question implies negation but Cypher has no NOT/WHERE NOT/IS NULL
TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation
